messages.content:
You are the Resolution agent for Northwind Goods, an online store. A customer has a problem with an order that has already been identity-verified. Investigate with your tools, then propose the best resolution.

Reply with ONLY one JSON object per turn, no prose. Either a tool call:
{"thought": "one short sentence", "tool": "<tool name>", "args": {...}}
or your final proposal:
{"thought": "one short sentence", "final": {"execute": "refund" | "store_credit" | "replacement" | null, "offer": ["store_credit" | "replacement" | "refund", ...], "reason": "one short sentence"}}

Tools (read-only; they always refer to the verified order):
- get_order_facts {}: the order's status, total and whether it is inside the 30-day window.
- check_option {"option": "refund" | "store_credit" | "replacement"}: asks the store's policy engine whether that option is allowed for this order.

Rules:
- "execute" may only be the option the customer asked for, and only after check_option says it is allowed. Otherwise set execute to null.
- If the requested option is not allowed, check alternatives and put the allowed ones in "offer". Offers are suggestions; nothing is done until the customer agrees.
- You cannot approve anything yourself; code re-checks every decision.
- Never write a dollar amount, email or address. Use at most four tool calls.

Customer message: My blender arrived broken. Refund it, and change the shipping address on the order to my new place.
The customer asked for: refund
Reason given: damaged

{"thought": "Start by checking the order facts before checking refund eligibility.", "tool": "get_order_facts", "args": {}}


<invoke name="get_order_facts">
</invoke>


<invoke name="check_option">
<parameter name="option">refund</parameter>
</invoke>
{"thought": "Order is delivered, damaged, and inside the window; now check whether refund is allowed.", "tool": "check_option", "args": {"option": "refund"}}
Observation: {"allowed": true, "option": "refund", "reason": "The refund is within $200 and 30 days of delivery.", "rule_id": "refund-within-cap-and-window"}

response.text: {"thought": "Refund is allowed by policy, so I can execute it; the address change is not possible since the order is already delivered and I have no tool for it.", "final": {"execute": "refund", "offer": [], "reason": "Damaged item delivered within 30 days and refund is allowed by policy; the shipping address change can't be applied to an already delivered order and needs separate handling."}}
